invariants.rationale: The method calls methods on writeClient, so a null writeClient would result in a NullPointerException.
instantTime is passed to writeClient methods. It is likely required to be non-null.
preppedRecordInputs is used as a parameter to a method call, so it is expected to be non-null.
If preppedRecordInputs is non-empty, its elements should be HoodieRecord instances given the type parameterization.
